tasks.description: Add release-aligned AI summarization core support for direct model construction [FR-001, FR-002]
tasks.acceptance: Core logic supports explicit summarization requests using direct direct-model construction, validates required inputs, uses explicit Aspose.Words API access with no reflective compatibility shims, and surfaces external failures clearly without silent fallback behavior.

tasks.description: Register an MCP summarization capability for the new AI surface [FR-001, FR-002]
tasks.acceptance: Server exposes a user-facing summarization tool wired to the new core logic with clear parameters, result reporting, and release-aligned tool metadata.

tasks.description: Add focused tests for AI summarization behavior and MCP surface exposure [FR-007, SC-001, SC-003]
tasks.acceptance: Targeted tests cover successful summarization invocation, required-input validation, explicit failure propagation, tool registration/schema exposure, and the end-to-end invocation path for the new capability.

tasks.description: Add options-based paragraph run-merging support in content operations [FR-003, FR-004, FR-005]
tasks.acceptance: Content operations support targeted paragraph run joining with configurable redundant, insignificant, and spacing options plus outcome reporting.

tasks.description: Register an MCP run-merging capability for paragraph normalization [FR-003, FR-004, FR-005]

tasks.description: Add focused tests for run-merging options and MCP surface exposure [FR-007, SC-002, SC-003, SC-005]
